title: Logo versions

location.series: IBM Logo Guidelines for Strategic Partners / Version 1.2 / copyright 2023

slide_intent: Choose an optically appropriate mark for the background so the striped letters retain their intended visual weight.
strategic_value: Using distinct positive and reversed artwork can preserve IBM recognition across light and dark settings.
demonstration: Black and white IBM logos are paired with enlarged M-counter details, exposing different bar widths and counter shapes.
practical_value: Select the supplied positive or reversed artwork rather than recoloring one version as a substitute.

content_islands.name: Version explanation
content_islands.spec: Place the two optical differences in the left column.

content_islands.name: Positive specimen
content_islands.spec: Use the upper right-area row for the black logo and enlarged sharp M counter.

content_islands.name: Reversed specimen
content_islands.spec: Use the lower row for the white-on-black logo and enlarged blunt counter, keeping the comparison aligned.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source explains that the two versions preserve legibility and optical integrity on light and dark backgrounds.
reference_purposes.Expression: The paired specimens expose the mark’s bar rhythm and distinct counter shapes.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The page requires the appropriate positive or reversed version for the background; the artworks are explicitly not identical.

ingredient.name: Positive and reversed 8-bar artwork
ingredient.role: Preserve optical weight across background tones.
ingredient.application: Use the appropriate supplied version rather than treating positive and reversed marks as simple color inversions.
ingredient.scope: IBM 8-bar logo artwork in the strategic-partner guide; bar widths and M counters differ between versions.
